prompts.glutling:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for CodeMap fantasy RPG. The supplied existing atlas is an IDENTITY AND ART STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Create ONE new atlas for the requested creature alone, preserving its exact recognizable design, proportions, colors, painted faceted chibi RPG shading. True transparent RGBA background with zero opaque backdrop, no ground shadow, no text, no grid lines. Precisely SIX equal columns and FOUR equal rows, landscape 1536x1024 layout, 24 isolated sprites, one per 256x256 cell. Keep generous transparent padding in every cell, constant creature scale, center x=cell center, identical foot baseline near 225px within each row. Row1 facing DOWN toward camera, row2 UP away from camera (show real back, no face), row3 LEFT screen profile, row4 RIGHT screen profile. Every row columns1-2: two subtle idle poses breathing/blink. Columns3-6: four distinct consecutive walking cycle poses with alternating feet. Same direction throughout each row. These are four real viewpoints, not rotating a flat picture. All parts incl horns, tails, leaves, flames stay inside their own cells. No other species or decorations.
Subject: GLUTLING, the orange four-legged fire salamander from row2 of reference: rounded orange head, big dark eyes, cream jaw and belly, short brown horn knobs, squat four paws, curling tail with bright yellow-orange flame. Keep body horizontal and tail fully visible in side views.
